information_contract.forwarding_links: consecutive UAV-UAV node pairs of env.routing_paths (the host's actual backhaul routes of that step), symmetrised; not the wider SINR adjacency env.uav_connections
information_contract.decision_end_rule: shortest len(env.routing_paths[i]) in the branch-point snapshot (held pre-event deployment); unrouted = +inf; ties -> lower index; no routed UAV -> lower index, decision_end_reason = 'no routed uav'
information_contract.clock: facts of step s (state after call s) govern call s + 1

definitions.delta_share: shared - unshared (post-event C_bh, per world, then paired)
definitions.post_event_window: series indices t_e..499; t_e from the host record, reporting only

per_world.decision_end_reason: shortest routing path at the branch-point snapshot
